subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: "What do you know about Rohingya?" said the teacher. "We know little about them. Please tell us something," said the students. "Let's discuss about this tribe today," said he. "O.K, sir. That will be very fine," said the students. "May God save them from this danger," said the teacher.
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech The teacher asked the students what they knew about Rohingya. The students replied that they knew little about them and requested him to tell them something. He suggested that they (S) should discuss about the tribe that day. The students said respectfully that it was okay and added that that would be very fine. The teacher prayed that God might save them from the danger.
